tool.name: Embedding search with FAISS
tool.description: look up entity descriptions in a FAISS knowledge-base index

param.name: input
param.label: Paragraphs with entities
param.help: JSON Lines, one object per paragraph, with a list of entities (by default the field "entities", as spaCy NLP Annotators writes it). Every entity needs "start" and "end" positions in its text.

param.name: entities_field
param.label: Field with the entities
param.help: The field of every item that lists its entities, each with "start" and "end" positions. spaCy NLP Annotators writes "entities". The results are written into the same list.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.

param.name: labels
param.label: Entity labels to look up
param.help: Labels separated by commas, for example NORP,LOC. Only entities with one of these labels are looked up; the others are left as they are. Capital letters do not matter. Leave empty to look up every entity.

validator.message: Write the labels separated by commas, using letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.

param.name: faiss_index
param.label: FAISS index
param.help: The FAISS index of the knowledge base.

param.name: metadata
param.label: Knowledge-base metadata (JSON Lines)
param.help: One JSON object per line. Line N describes vector N of the index.

param.name: id_field
param.label: ID field in the metadata
param.help: The field that identifies an entry, copied into the results. Leave empty to use the line number (starting at 0).

validator.message: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.

param.name: embedding_model
param.label: Embedding model
param.help: The model that built the index. The index does not say which one it was, and a different model gives wrong results.
param.option: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (small, for indexes built with it)

param.name: query_prompt
param.label: Query prompt
param.help: The name of the model's prompt for search queries (EmbeddingGemma uses SearchQuery). Leave empty if the model has none.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only.

param.name: top_k
param.label: Results per entity
param.help: How many candidates to keep for the reranking step. 30 (default).

param.name: normalize
param.label: Normalize the query vectors
param.help: Keep this on if the index was built from normalized vectors, as is usual for cosine similarity.

tool.help:
**Embedding search with FAISS** finds, for every entity in a text, the entries of a knowledge base that fit it best. It embeds the mention of the entity and looks the vector up in a FAISS index. It can follow any step that finds entities, such as an NER tool, and can be followed by a reranking step.
Input -----
* **Texts with entities**: JSON or JSON Lines, for example the output of spaCy NLP Annotators with named entity recognition::
{"text": "He sailed to Delphi.", "entities": [{"start": 14, "end": 20, "label": "GPE"}]}
The mention is the text from ``start`` to ``end``, and it is what is looked up. Only entities whose label is in the **Entity labels** list are looked up (by default ``NORP,LOC``); the rest are left as they are. Empty the list to look up every entity.
* **FAISS index** and **metadata**: the knowledge base. Line N of the metadata (JSON Lines) describes vector N of the index, so they must come from the same knowledge base. Any knowledge base works, as long as the index and the metadata match. * **Embedding model**: the model that built the index. The tool checks that its vectors have the size of the index, but it cannot tell two models of the same size apart, so choose the right one.
Output ------
The same JSON Lines, with ``index_results`` added to every entity: the ids of the nearest entries, best first. Galaxy has no JSON Lines datatype, so the file is labelled ``json``.
The model is downloaded when the job runs, so the server needs internet access.
